concern_summary: This concern involves the functionalities related to managing text input lines, including updating user input with the potential for mentions in context that may include line breaks.
This concern encompasses the functionalities for processing line break elements in text, including their conversion to newline characters, spaces, or removal to create a continuous line.

This concern encompasses the management and editing of messages related to the 'h1 test message', allowing users to draft, update, and report comments effectively while ensuring that all changes are optimally reflected in the application state.
This concern focuses on text layout and rendering, including calculations for line height, total line counts, and rendering individual lines of text.
This concern deals with chat message functionalities, covering the management of user interactions such as searching, filtering, and displaying user messages within chat environments.
This concern focuses on the validation and extraction of information within text messages, including emoji checks, email extraction, and content updates based on user interactions.
This concern addresses changes in member status, generating messages that reflect membership actions and ensuring proper formatting in displays.
